content: Metam Masedoniyahi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbop hatiiŋ adi lodagiŋ
Notneye, Bepaŋ’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋdi Masedoniyahi’walaŋ kayoŋbop gineŋ kwanai tubune titiŋ momooŋ tigiŋ wondiniŋ mede hanimbe nadineŋ.
Adi yadi goliŋgoliŋ wapum gineŋ hatiŋale bomboŋdok lohilohi tiŋa hambeep hinek hatiiŋ. Iŋgoŋ oŋ, Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋdok nadifo wapum tiŋa yegiŋ e, siloŋdok bomboŋ feegoŋ boiŋa tiulidokogiŋ.
Nu adi agaŋ nadiyem hinek tilat. Adi yadi nehi welehikdi lodaune saŋiniŋhikdok tuwolit boigiŋ iŋgoŋ oŋ, u-kabe kalakapmeeŋ boigiŋ.
Indi unduŋ titiŋdok mu yeniŋgumun, iŋgoŋ nehigoŋ gigine tiŋa wanaŋ titiŋdok yofafaŋeeŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ metam yehiulihiŋa siloŋdok bomboŋ tubumintaaŋ yehitubu-lodadok yogiŋ.
Tiŋa nemek loŋgoŋ be tinetiiŋ yo yabugumun, de. Adi indiŋ tigiŋ, timeŋ nehi’walaŋ hatihatihik u Wapumdok miŋgiŋ. Agaŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ nadisuhebet keleeŋ hatihatihik u inditok maaŋ nimgiŋ.
Wapum’walaŋ metam yehitubu-lodadok bomboŋ bopnegiŋ
Adi unduŋ tigiŋ doktiŋa Taitusdi hidut siloŋ kwanai titawooŋ diki wabigiŋ uye koti tububila titawooŋ tubudapmandok nindapmayam.

Hidi nadisukiliti, eŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede yohauta, eŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede diniŋ mebi nadidakale, eŋ kwanaidok gigine, eŋ indi welesiloŋ tinimdok, nemek undihidok folooŋ fee tubumintagiŋ, ala yoŋ adi siloŋdok yoŋit wondok undugoŋ lodaaŋ tineeŋ.
Nu haniŋgigine tiŋa mu yolat ale. Adi tobo metam noli Bepaŋ nadisukilitimiiŋdi lodaloda tubumintagiŋ. Ala hidi’walaŋ welesiloŋ dediniŋgoŋ hatak wondiniŋ mebi miŋgoŋ mintadakaledok wendok yolat.

Hidi Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ diniŋ mebi agaŋ nadiiŋ. Adi yadi duhuduhu wapumnitdi hiditok tiŋa fiyewakaŋ tuguk. Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, uyadi fiyewakaŋ hatiŋale hehitubu-lodaune hidi duhuduhunit titiŋdok unduŋ tuguk.
Yoŋ adi mede hogok hanilat ale mede tiloloŋ tubune folooŋnit tibaak. Biyagoŋ, hidi gulet komi gineŋ agaŋ lodaaŋ tububihila muneeŋ kamegiŋ.
Ala u tomboyoula tubudapmaune titiŋhik loŋgoŋ tiiŋ wondiniŋ folooŋ nemek hahamulak wondok tuwolit mintawaak.

Meeniŋ nediyeŋ weleŋdi hinek lodaune siloŋdok nemek kamelak wondok Bepaŋdi nadiune tuwot hinek tubune netok kahilelak. Unduŋ doktiŋa siloŋdok nemek kamekame uyadi nemek halimilak wondok tuwolit gineŋ kameluwaak. Eŋ fiyewakaŋ hinek adi Bepaŋdi agaŋ kaŋ nadilak.
Meeniŋ welenadifo foloŋ nemek siloŋ tiyembune moŋgotdok yeniŋit adi gitagoŋ hatimoloune hide hogok kwanai wapum titiŋdok moŋ ale.

Adi tobo hidi’walaŋ bomboŋ feedi adi’walaŋ baniŋhik keleune uune tuwot tuwot titiŋdok yoŋit. Ala kougoŋ hatigene hidibo baniŋ tubune adi’walaŋ bomboŋ feedi hidi’walaŋ baniŋhik keleune uune bomboŋhik tuwot tuwot tineeŋ.
Youkudip indiŋ hatak. “Fee ugamakiŋdi fiit duhuduhunit mokit tigiŋ, eŋ lufom-kabe ugamakiŋdi baniŋ mu tigiŋ.”
Taitus eŋ noliŋiyat menot tiyemdok mede
Bepaŋ adi Taitus weleŋ tubulodaune nu’walaŋ walanedi hiditok tiŋa koloŋgoŋ yatak, undigoŋ adi maaŋ nadilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋdok welemomooŋ nadimiŋa niutumbanim.
Tiŋa indi niŋgumun wondok hogok tiŋa moŋ, negoŋ weleŋdi agaŋ loda hinek tiŋa uuŋdok yolak.
Tiŋa me notnik niŋ, Jesu noŋgoŋ nadisukilitimiyam adi yadi Bepaŋ medeŋiŋ doktiŋa kwanai momooŋ tilak. Adi kayoŋbop hogohogokdi kaune utumba tilak adi maaŋ niŋkutnene wamuk.
Bepaŋ’walaŋ kayoŋbop adi me adikuyeŋ siloŋdok fukut moŋgola nihitubu-lodadok nindapmagiŋ. Kwanai uyadi welenikdi lodaune Wapum nintiloŋ tiyam.
Meeniŋ nolidi niniŋkadaka tineeneŋ yoŋa muneeŋ wapum u meeniŋ feedi kanadi tiŋa ugamali bopneyam.
Indi nemek tiyam uyadi Wapumdi nadiune utumbadok hogok moŋ. Uyadi meeniŋdi maaŋ nadiune tuwot titiŋdok nadiŋa yoyam.

Tiŋa indi meyat adut notnik niŋ wanaŋ yeniŋkutnene wiiŋ, me uyadi nai noli gineŋ kwanai tikatikadok ninene kedem hinek tubune kagumun. Nai indide adi hidi siloŋ kwanai kedem tineeŋ nadilak doktiŋa welelufom mu tiŋa hehitubu-lodadok nadigalika tilak.

Hidi Taitus agaŋ nadimiiŋ, adi nukut kwanai noŋgoŋ tiyamut. Indi hidi’walaŋ kwanai-meyat noŋgoŋ hatiyamut. Eŋ notniyat aditok maaŋ indiŋ nadineŋ. Adi yadi Kilisto wou nintilooŋ kwanaineyamuk ala kayoŋbopdi yeniŋkulune wanaŋ wiiŋ.
Indi hidi hanintiloyam diniŋ mede wondi folooŋnit titiŋdok adi meeniŋ undihidi usuwaune hidi menot tiyembune kayoŋbop nolidi u nadineeŋ.
